purpose: Cache-only paired comparison of blind BLS recovery and frozen external-embedding sensitivity to injected transits on 48 ASAS-SN-matched TESS variability backgrounds

target_selection.product_rule: largest expected byte size per TIC, then lowest sector, then lexical cache path

injection_policy.flux_operation: multiplicative box transit on full quality-filtered PDCSAP flux

embedding_policy.weights: frozen exact-revision ONNX files already present in .cache/representation_models
embedding_policy.sampling: deterministic evenly spaced indices over the full quality-filtered sector baseline
embedding_policy.normalization: relative magnitude using one shared original-series median per TIC

parallel_shape.worker_scope: FITS preparation and blind BLS trials
parallel_shape.embedding_scope: one frozen session per model per shard; inference serialized within the shard to avoid 36 duplicate model sessions

limitations: ASAS-SN classes are automated outputs and remain training-disabled.
This is a paired sensitivity benchmark, not a classifier fit, survey-completeness estimate, or production promotion gate.
The four-cell injection grid reuses bounded regimes from production_sensitivity_v2 and does not cover long-period, TTV, single-transit, or image-level systematics.
No embedding array, modified light curve, FITS product, model weight, or catalog payload may be written or downloaded.
A successful execution authorizes scientific interpretation only; training, promotion, and production scoring remain unauthorized.
